clientDenyPolicies.model: Every current vacleaner_* table is RLS-enabled. Referral tables, including referral message analytics, use explicit restrictive ALL-deny policies; address cache has no browser allow policy and therefore defaults to deny.

retentionVerification.loyaltyPromoRule: Ordinary promo/manual does not stack with loyalty or earned referral. Earned referral may stack with permanent loyalty. Compare complete benefit; on an exact tie with an earned referral, preserve the referral for a future rental.
